title_sq: Apartament 2+1 te Rruga e Barrikadave per shitje.
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 te Rruga e Barrikadave per shitje. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje objekti te ri qe perfundon ne korrik 2025 ne rrugen e Barrikadave. Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale 104.5 m2, organizohet ne nje sallon, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon. Apartamenti ka orientim Lindje. Objekti eshte nje nder objektet me cilesore te zones ku vlen te permendet fasada e ventiluar, 3 ashensore, 3 kate parkim i nendheshem edhe shume detaje te tjera luksoze.
Cmimi 282000 euro
title_en: 2+1 apartment on Barricade Street for sale.
description_en: 2+1 apartment on Barricade Street for sale. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new building that will be completed in July 2025 on Barricadave street. The apartment has a total area of ​​104.5 m2, it is organized in a living room, two bedrooms, two toilets and a balcony. The apartment has an East orientation. The facility is one of the highest quality facilities in the area, where it is worth mentioning the ventilated facade, 3 elevators, 3 floors of underground parking and many other luxurious details. The price is 282,000 euros
